question: Where can I get the planned new power lines and substations in Spain, with location, voltage, planned date and status?

answer.summary: No structured national file of planned lines and substations was found. The official lists are PDF tables with voltage and planned year: the approved Plan 2021-2026 (consolidated July 2026) and the initial 2025-2030 proposal (Annex I). Coordinates and a 3-state status exist only in Red Eléctrica's project map (385 substations, 77 lines, updated September 2024). Distribution-grid plans were not obtained.
main_caveats: Plan PDFs have no coordinates; match by substation name to the REE map points. The map lines are straight segments between two substations, not routes.
Planned years are best estimates; several are already past in a 2026 consolidation. The approved plan is 2021-2026; 2025-2030 is only a proposal under revision.
The revised 2030 proposal (September 2026: 193 substation parks, 6,706 km of lines) was announced but its documents were not found; Annex I here is the October 2025 version.
REE map status is dated September 2024; projects completed since may still show 'En proceso'.
Distribution-grid (below 220 kV, regional) planned assets were not obtained from any source.
answer.confidence_reason: PDFs, JSON and API opened and tested; distribution and OSM left unchecked (portal 503, Overpass unreachable) and the 2030 XLSX could not be downloaded.

how_to_use.example_result: Page 197 (printed page 196), Anexo II, actuación AF_05 'Alimentación eje ferroviario Madrid-Albacete-Alicante-Valencia': 'Nuevas subestaciones | Tipo | Prev.: Torrejón de Velasco 400 kV | Intemp. | 2025'; 'Nuevas líneas/cables | MVA [inv.] | MVA [ver.] | km (±10%) | Tipo | Motiv. | Prev.: E/S en Torrejón de Velasco, de Morata - Villaviciosa 400 kV, cto 1 | 1.310 | 750 | 2 | Línea | EjeFerr. | 2025'
steps: Download the PDF (98.6 MB, just under the 100 MB limit) and run pdftotext -layout; the file has a real text layer (no OCR needed).

Split the text on form feeds (one per page). Fact-sheet pages carry the heading 'Actuación <code>' and the sub-tables 'Nuevas subestaciones', 'Ampliación de subestaciones', 'Nuevas líneas/cables', 'Repotenciación de líneas', 'Cambios de conductor', 'Nuevos transformadores'. Annex II (new actions) starts around PDF page 187; Annex I (starting grid) around page 148.

Layout mode interleaves the side-menu words (Introducción, Metodología, Resultados...) and two-column tables; rebuild rows by splitting on runs of 3+ spaces and keep rows whose last cell is a 4-digit year.

The assets carry no coordinates: location is the substation name (and, for lines, the two substation names). Join to substation coordinates from the REE project map (rank 3) by name, or locate by hand.
Status: the plan gives only the section (Red de partida / Nuevas actuaciones / more than 2026) and the planned year; execution status must come from rank 3 or from BOE notices (if_unstructured).
reading_traps: Prev. is 'Mejor estimación del año para la puesta en servicio' (best-estimate year), not a commitment; several years are already in the past (2021-2024) in a document consolidated in 2026.
Table headers in the unit table count km of circuit while the detail table counts km of route: they do not add up.
The same substation appears on several rows (one per motive, e.g. Almendrales 400 kV twice) and one project can span several fact sheets: sum with care.

pdftotext -layout puts navigation words of the side menu inside table lines; a plain-regex parse of Annex II in this test returned 41 new-substation rows and 196 line rows, which is a lossy lower bound, not an inventory.
Distribution-grid assets are not listed; only transport-distribution interface positions (motive ApD).

problems: HEAD requests return 403 (Incapsula) while GET works; the portal answers GET to the default curl client
No structured file (CSV/GIS) of the plan on the portal; planificacionelectrica.es 'Accede a la Planificación' links to a PDF only

recipe: 1. Take the transmission list from ranks 1 and 2: extract the sub-tables 'Nuevas subestaciones' and 'Nuevas líneas/cables' (and extensions) per actuación with pdftotext -layout; keep name, kV, Tipo, Motiv., Prev. (tested on PDF pages 197 and 205).

2. Add location by joining substation names to the points of the REE project map (rank 3); lines are drawn between their two substation names. Names differ in spelling (e.g. 'Almodovar Del Rio' vs 'Almodóvar del Río'), so match after normalising case and accents; unmatched substations need manual location.

3. Add status per project: map status (rank 3, dated 2024-09) and, for assets in permitting, the BOE notices (search the substation or line name; the notice gives the stage: información pública, AAP, AAC, DIA/IIA).
4. For assets below 220 kV or distribution, search regional lists (rank 5 pattern) and distributor investment plans; none was obtained in this pass.
if_unstructured.location_method: Plan PDFs carry no coordinates. Use REE map points by substation name; for lines, the two end substations; BOE environmental and authorisation documents describe municipalities and sometimes include coordinates in annexes (not tested).

where_published.name: BOE section V-B and III (announcements, authorisations and environmental resolutions)
where_published.what: Public-information notices and resolutions for individual substations and lines: promoter, municipality, voltage, technology, file number and whether the action belongs to the plan
where_published.how_to_search_inside: BOE text search or daily summary; search for 'subestación', 'línea eléctrica', 'Red Eléctrica de España' and 'autorización administrativa previa'; regional gazettes carry the same for regionally authorised assets. Search is by words only; no structured fields.

example_document.what_it_gives: Anuncio 31759, 2026-10-01, Huelva: 'ampliación de la subestación Puebla de Guzmán en el parque de 400 kV con una nueva posición de interruptor y la máquina asociada (reactancia REA-1)', titular Red Eléctrica de España, expediente 151/2026; says it is included in the 'Tercera modificación ... Plan de desarrollo ... 2021-2026' (BOE 8 August 2026)

where_published.name: MITECO SABIA environmental assessment consultation
where_published.what: Environmental assessment files for state projects with their processing status
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Choose activity from a provincial or autonomous-community map and combine with dropdown filters (page description); the SABIA application itself was not opened.

where_published.name: Regional public-information lists (example Aragón)
where_published.what: Lines and substations in public information with voltage and municipality in the title

example_document.what_it_gives: 'Centro de seccionamiento "Puerto Venecia" a 132 kV en el término municipal de Zaragoza'

where_published.name: Third modification annex (51 actions), MITECO
where_published.what: 8-page PDF with an annex table: asset, year, voltage, community or island, origin and destination substation, subtype, value, unit
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Read the annex table with pdftotext -layout; only the 51 actions of the July 2026 modification

example_document.what_it_gives: 'Reactancia San Jorge 132 kV REA1, 20 MVAr | 2026 | SEB | Ibiza | SAN JORGE | 132 ... Nuevo cable | Subterraneo | 0,5 | km'

related_not_answering.name: TYNDP 2024 investment candidates and Starting grid 2030 (XLSX)
related_not_answering.why: Border-level transfer capacities and costs between market areas (ES-FR, ES-PT, ES-MA), no substations or lines with location

related_not_answering.name: Red Eléctrica list of NextGenerationEU-financed projects
related_not_answering.why: Project codes and names (e.g. 'J-00A6-S1450 - SE/Sagunto GIS 220 kV (Ampl.)') for a subset financed by EU funds; no voltage, date or location fields

related_not_answering.name: REE press and PCI page (Spanish PCIs)
related_not_answering.why: Short narrative list of interconnection projects with 2023-2027 horizons that are dated; not a list of planned lines and substations

related_not_answering.name: MITECO press releases on the 2030 proposal
related_not_answering.why: National and regional totals (substation parks, km, investment) without asset-level rows

related_not_answering.name: e-distribución Planes de Inversión 2028-2030 page
related_not_answering.why: Consultation form for the 2028-2030 plans open 15 October to 5 December 2026; it does not publish assets

open_questions: What does the XLSX 'Nueva propuesta fase alegaciones' (MITECO 2030 hearing page, host ssweb.seap.minhap.es) contain? It returned 503 on 5 attempts; only the organisation can say whether it is a structured action list.
Is the revised 2025-2030 proposal of September 2026 published as documents? The press release says it will go to Congress and the Council of Ministers; no document was found on the pages opened.

history.note: First pass: planned assets exist as official PDF tables (plan 2021-2026, proposal 2025-2030) with voltage and year but no coordinates; REE map gives points and status, last updated 2024-09.

local_terms.term: planificación de la red de transporte de energía eléctrica
local_terms.meaning: Binding national plan of transmission assets
Interim modification of the plan approved by the Council of Ministers
A project group and its fact sheet in the plan annexes
Starting grid: already in construction or advanced when the plan was drawn
Mejor estimación del año para la puesta en servicio

local_terms.term: autorización administrativa previa (AAP) / de construcción (AAC) / DUP
local_terms.meaning: Permit steps for a line or substation; announced in BOE section V-B
Loop-in of an existing line into a new substation
Substation yard / bay of equipment inside it

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
